items.synopsis: FPC gets stuck at 100% utilization after upgrade from 21.2R1 or below to 21.3R1 or higher release
items.description: On Junos MX platforms with PPPoE (point-to-point protocol over ethernet) subscribers over dynamic VLAN (virtual local area network) scenario, FPC (flexible physical interface cards concentrator) gets stuck at 100% after upgrade from 21.2R1 or below to 21.3R1 or higher release. The line card PFE (packet forwarding engine) is busy because of huge punt traffic which is process-switched by the CPU.

items.synopsis: MX304 not reachable with the power-off failure on the PIC
items.description: When an MX304 LMIC is offline due to a power issue, it may take up to 20 minutes for the LMIC to come back online. You can configure event-options to reduce the time to restart the LMIC. See also: TSB83899

items.synopsis: Telemetry data is not exported in an IS-IS scaled Segment Routing scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with SR-ISIS and with gRPC/gNMI telemetry, subscription to the path: "/junos/services/segment-routing/sid/usage/" will not work and the output could not be proper. The issue could happen only in scaled configuration (Approximately, 4000 or more per-sid ingress sensors and 4000 or more IPv4/IPv6 per-sid egress sensors are configured).

items.synopsis: JDHCPD core dumps in tcp_io_reader may be seen on ALQ setups when subscriber synchronization happens
items.description: DHCP ALQ (Active Leasequery) Sessions go down due to core dumps in JDHCPD (Juniper DHCP Daemon). These JDHCPD core dumps in tcp_io_reader may be seen on ALQ setups when subscriber synchronization happens after the TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) connection comes up.

items.synopsis: On SRX Series devices, when using IPv6 Multi-path BGP with MX configured with EVPN, transit SFW traffic experiences packet drops during IPv6 Neighbor discovery refresh.
items.description: On SRX Series devices, when using IPv6 Multi-path BGP with MX configured with EVPN, transit SFW traffic experiences packet drops during IPv6 Neighbor discovery refresh.

items.synopsis: Product annotation missing for sensors for specific platforms
items.description: Product annotation files with correct product support/exclude information for specific sensors with respect to platform MX, PTX and EX92XX products. Request customer to enable CLI "set services analytics product-path-check no-path-check" configure to override product annotation issue.

items.synopsis: PIM Prune is not sent to upstream
items.description: With RPF-vector TLV PIM prune message might not be sent out of upstream interface when corresponding prune message received from last downstream interface (i.e. S, G state needs to be removed).

items.category: RPD route tables, resolver, routing instances, static routes
items.synopsis: BGP backup routes are installed as primary routes after enabling 'protect core' feature
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms when Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) multipath is enabled for Layer 3 Virtual Private Network (L3VPN) routes and 'protect core' is enabled on the Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) instance, the backup BGP path is installed as primary path. The Next hop weight value is not updated correctly, it is weight 0x1 instead of weight 0x4000 for the backup.

items.synopsis: Faulty MPC8 or MPC9 line cards can lead to spontaneous chassisd crash on certain Junos MX platforms
items.description: On Junos MX2008, MX2010, MX2020 platforms, if a faulty MPC8 or MPC9 line card is present in the chassis, chassisd process may crash and triggers routing-engine switchover.

items.synopsis: Interface Connectivity issue with MPC10E on Member 1, Slot 0 in MX Virtual Chassis
items.description: On all Junos in MX-Virtual-Chassis (MXVC) setups involving MPC10E Flexible PIC Concentrators (FPCs) on member #1 in slot #0 causes incorrect interface number conversion, leading to all interfaces being down on this FPC. This problem affects any MXVC configuration with MPC10 FPCs positioned in this slot.

items.category: Issues related to broadband edge apps (PPP, DHCP) on Trio ch
items.synopsis: Traffic drop due to mac-validate failure on MX platforms
items.description: On Junos MX platforms, when subscriber management is enabled and mac-validate is configured on interfaces, traffic drop is seen while attempting to add a new link to an existing AE (Aggregate Ethernet) bundle from a different FPC.

items.synopsis: The console login no longer works after software upgrade when having "system services ... authentication-order ..." configuration stanza
items.description: With the "system services ... authentication-order ..." configuration stanza, the console login will no longer work. See also TSB85280.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The system scripts refresh will fail when using load CLI option
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms when the 'edit system scripts' hierarchy configuration is changed using loading a configuration from a file or the terminal using 'load' option, the scripts refresh will fail.

items.synopsis: UTM Web filtering does not work for HTTPS traffic sent from Google Chrome browser or MS Edge v124
items.description: On SRX platforms, Unified Threat Management (UTM) web filtering does not work for Hypertext transfer protocol secure (HTTPS) traffic sent from Google Chrome browser or MS Edge v124.

items.synopsis: Macsec do not work when interface is transparent mode
items.description: MACSec is supported in routing mode but not in transparent mode.

items.synopsis: MX and ACX platforms running Virtual Extensible LAN Multi Protocol Label Switching (VX-LAN MPLS) in Data Center Interconnect (DCI) stitching environments will experience catastrophic traffic disruption
items.description: On Junos OS and Junos Evolved MX and ACX platforms with VX-LAN symmetric route stitching between data center networks enabled the Control Word (CW) flag changes will trigger catastrophic behavior and traffic disruption in the Packet Forwarding Enginee (PFE)

items.synopsis: vmcore on device with evpn-vxlan configs
items.description: Graceful Routing Engine Switchover (GRES) not supporting the configuration of a private route, such as fxp0 , when imported into a non-default instance or logical system. Please see KB https://kb.juniper.net/InfoCenter/index?page=content&id=KB26616 resolution rib policy is required to apply as a work-around

items.synopsis: Packet drops on Inter Chassis Datapath (ICD) link in Multinode High Availability (MnHA) configuration
items.description: On all SRX platforms with Multinode High Availability (MnHA) configuration, some packets will be dropped when traffic traverses the Inter Chassis Datapath (ICD) link.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss for VPN going down due to inconsistency between the VPN configuration in the iked and the service-redundancy-group database
items.description: On certain SRX platforms using iked (Internet Key Exchange Protocol Daemon) with IPsec (Internet Protocol Security) and MNHA (Multi-Node High Availability) configured, traffic loss can occur when the VPN (Virtual Private Network) service-redundancy-group becomes active and there is a configuration mismatch between the iked and ikemd (Internet Key Exchange Protocol Management Daemon) services. This issue arises if the reconciliation process takes over 5 minutes and the VPN service-redundancy-group switches to backup before completing the reconciliation, especially with a high number of VPN tunnels (up to 16, 000) and VPN IKE traceoptions set to the highest level.

items.synopsis: Display issue is observed when range option is used to configure destination/source port range in custom application
items.description: On Junos SRX platform, J-web shows error message "The maximum length for this field is 9", when range option is used to configure destination/source port range in custom application and if the value is more than 10 characters.

items.synopsis: MAC addresses learnt on interfaces part of VLAN with MAC limiting by interface and "drop-and-log" action configured are cleared after VLAN description is changed
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when "set vlans switch-options interface-mac-limit packet-action drop-and-log" is configured, changing the Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) description will cause flush of Media Access Control (MAC) addresses learnt on the interfaces part of the VLAN and traffic impact

items.synopsis: [Clocking Solution]:MX480:PTP state went to Freerun and acquiring upon SyncE ESMC is disabled/downgraded from GM or the upstream node one hop above the parent node
items.description: PTP state went to Freerun and acquiring before phase-aligning again when the SyncE ESMC is disabled or downgraded from GM or the upstream node one hop above the parent node

items.synopsis: The rpd process crashes during rpd restart on Junos and Junos Evolved platforms
items.description: This is a timing issue during the restart of rpd. When a new rpd comes up, during bulk-sync, the flagged entries are getting deleted later at kernel, which will not be notified to RPD (master rpd), so RPD is unaware of this delete and holds this entry in DBs, which leads to non-sync between kernel and rpd process.

items.category: Track usability related J-Web PR, like UI layout, workflow
items.synopsis: J-Web: Unable to Define NAT Policy Address Names Containing Dots or Slashes
items.description: On all SRX Junos platforms, unable to add/edit any field in NAT policy from J-Web if destination address name '.' dot or '/' slash.

items.synopsis: Monitored-Status keeps Up after CTL link down in branch model SRX HA
items.description: After CTL link down, Monitored-Status in "show chassis cluster interfaces" keeps showing "Up" state.

items.category: MPC7E, MPC8E and MPC9E timing and synchronization
items.synopsis: [MX] Configured queue is not honored for outbound PTP traffic
items.description: Configured queue is not honored for outbound PTP traffic. Instead packets go out on queue 0 or network control queue 3

items.synopsis: NSD validation failure results into upgrade failure for Junos MX platforms
items.description: On Junos MX240, MX480, MX960 platforms, the Network Security Daemon (nsd) validation fails during upgrades.
